exact_conclusion: For every 0<d<4 and positive integer N, some monic polynomial has at least N distinct closed unit-sublevel components of diameter greater than d. In particular the original bound fails at c=1.
assumptions: Standard logarithmic capacity and Green-function identities
scope_exclusions: Asymptotic o(n) or o(n^epsilon) follow-on questions
Effective degree bound or explicit coefficients
Proof for every sufficiently large prescribed degree
